posts.text: Aave Labs has bought the team and tech behind Avon to add fixed-rate lending to its onchain lending network. The deal covers Avon's fixed and floating-rate protocols, an onchain order book and domains, terms undisclosed. Aave says it holds more than 30 billion USD in deposits and 12 billion USD in active loans.
